description: Displays a single month view for the `v-date-picker` component.

props.allowedDates: Sets the allowed dates of the month.
props.hideWeekdays: Hide the days of the week letters.
props.max: Sets the maximum date of the month.
props.min: Sets the minimum date of the month.
props.multiple: Sets the multiple of the month.
props.readonly: Puts the picker in a readonly state.
props.transition: The transition used when changing months into the future
props.reverseTransition: The transition used when changing months into the past
props.wheel: Navigate between months with the mouse wheel or trackpad. Responds to horizontal scrolling or Shift + wheel.
props.events: Array of dates or object defining events or colors or function returning boolean/color/array of colors.
props.eventColor: Sets the color for event dots. It can be string (all events will have the same color) or `object` where attribute is the event date and value is boolean/color/array of colors for specified date or `function` taking date as a parameter and returning boolean/color/array of colors for that date.
props.noAutoNavigation: Prevents the displayed month from automatically following the selected value.
props.previewValue: Hovered date while picking the end of a range, used to preview the range.

events.boundary-navigate: Emitted when keyboard navigation moves past the displayed month while **no-auto-navigation** is set. Receives `{ direction, targetIsoDate }`.
events.update:previewValue: Emitted when the hovered date changes while picking the end of a range.

slots.day: Slot for a day in the month.

exposed.focusGrid: Moves focus to the days grid.
exposed.focusItem: Moves focus to the given date (ISO string).
